en.headline: Kerry wins Ho Man Tin site for over 4.3 billion dollars
en.dek: The Lands Department said Kerry Properties took the Fat Kwong Street residential lot, at more than 20,738 dollars per square foot of floor area, well above market forecasts.
body: The Lands Department said on Tuesday that Kerry Properties had won the Fat Kwong Street residential site in Ho Man Tin with a bid of more than 4.308 billion dollars.

RTHK reported the price was far above the upper end of market expectations, at more than 20,738 dollars per square foot of floor area. The tender closed last Friday with 10 bids. The lot sits near the Ultima development, Ho Man Tin Park, a service reservoir and a ventilation building for the Central Kowloon Route.

The maximum gross floor area is nearly 208,000 square feet, and the site is expected to yield about 250 flats. The developer must build a neighbourhood elderly centre sub-base and an integrated community centre for mental wellness sub-base, and hand both to the government at no cost.

zh.headline: 嘉里逾43.08億投得何文田佛光街住宅地
zh.dek: 地政總署公布作價遠高於市場預期上限，每平方呎樓面地價逾20738元，上周五截標共收10份標書。
body: 地政總署星期二公布，嘉里建設以逾43.08億元投得何文田佛光街住宅地。
港台報道，作價遠高於市場預期上限，每平方呎樓面地價逾20738元。項目上星期五截標，接獲十份標書。地皮鄰近豪宅天鑄、何文田公園和配水庫，以及中九龍繞道行車隧道的通風大樓。
最高可建樓面近20.8萬平方呎，預計可提供約250個單位。發展商須興建一所長者鄰舍中心分處及一所精神健康綜合社區中心分處，並無償移交政府。
